label: Founded by God immediately: In the strong rival gloss, God's own constitutive act establishes the…
definition: In the strong rival gloss, God's own constitutive act establishes the society without an envoy or creature supplying that constitutive act. An envoy's authorization alone does not make the act God's own. This stronger exclusion is not entailed merely by calibrating FoundedAsTeachingAuthority to a direct-founding relation. In the encoded Jesus-specific comparison, STMT-DIVINE-FOUNDING-IS-EXCLUSIVE-IMMEDIATE adds an explicit exclusion for commissioned Jesus events; the full exclusion is now encoded separately by ImmediateWithoutCreature: Direct g c and, for every being x, if IsCreature x or HoldsMandate x g then x does not supply the constitutive founding act of c for g. This is a pointwise rival criterion, not a calibration of the unchanged root predicate.
note: Rival sense recorded so that the envoy-founding premise cannot pass silently between senses. No corpus statement uses it as its reading of FoundedAsTeachingAuthority; a source defending it (for example an ecclesiology for which only an invisible church is God's own work) would make it a sourced rival. Minimal direct calibration, Jesus-specific exclusion, and a nonempty commissioned-event witness are separate propositions. The old universal claim that an immediate-only reading makes the envoy bridge false was too strong: compatibility can hold, and without events the bridge is vacuous. No identity or distinctness of Jesus and a God candidate is inferred. Declaration completion (2026-11-09): Profile explicitly supplies Direct, IsCreature and SuppliesAct as primitive interpretation inputs, with ordinary charter-making as an analogy only. SuppliesAct excludes mere authorization, witnessing, later teaching or maintenance. No identity, creaturehood, divine nature, or act-supply fact about Jesus is inferred. No asymmetry, transitivity, well-foundedness or other structural law is assumed for these relations. Applicability to divine founding and links from FoundedInMandate to SuppliesAct remain OPEN. Every being in Signature is quantified; no restricted creature model is substituted. jointControl witnesses nonvacuity with an actual God, direct founding and creatures. fragmentInsufficient shows the existing Jesus-only exclusion plus direct calibration can hold while full exclusion fails. No source attribution or root bridge changes.
